--[[
	WidgetSections  -  Part-Icles V5
	Copyright (C) 2026 Qwinkle
	Sections, expandable groups, slider and collapse button.
	Loaded by Widgets.luau  -  receives the shared W table and adds functions to it.
]]

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local BuildPacer = require(script.Parent.BuildPacer)
local TypeScale = require(script.Parent.TypeScale)
local PanelSizes = require(script.Parent.PanelSizes)
local T = C.T
local LAYOUT = C.LAYOUT

return function(W)
	local addCorner, addStroke, addPadding, addListLayout = W.addCorner, W.addStroke, W.addPadding, W.addListLayout
	-- Call W.getUISConnections() fresh at each site  -  reset() replaces the table.

	-- Read-only path display for EmitParent
	function W.makePathLabel(name, parent)
		local f = W.makeBlob(name.."Wrap", parent, UDim2.new(1,-LAYOUT.ContentOffset,0,LAYOUT.RowHeight))
		local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel"); lbl.Name = name; lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		lbl.Text = "none"; lbl.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold; lbl.Font = T.Font; lbl.TextSize = 9
		lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; lbl.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
		lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1,-8,1,0); lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0,4,0,0); lbl.Parent = f
		if not C.MODE.Structure.Classic then
			-- Same text size and inset as the fields around it.
			TypeScale.style(lbl, "Value")
			lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, LAYOUT.FieldPad, 0, 0)
			lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -LAYOUT.FieldPad * 2, 1, 0)
		end
		return lbl, f
	end

	-- Shared floating dots menu (created once per Build, repositioned on each open)
	function W.buildDotsMenu(screenGui)
		if not C.MODE.Structure.Classic then
			-- PropertyInputsPE reads the menu's width from its Size and finds "Paste" by name.
			local popup = W.makeMenu(screenGui, "DotsMenu", PanelSizes.get().DotsMenu)
			popup.ZIndex = 20
			return {
				CopyBtn = W.makeMenuItem(popup, "Copy", "Copy graph", 0),
				PasteBtn = W.makeMenuItem(popup, "Paste", "Paste graph", 1),
				ResetBtn = W.makeMenuItem(popup, "Reset", "Reset default", 2),
				Menu = popup,
			}
		end
		local menu = Instance.new("Frame"); menu.Name = "DotsMenu"
		menu.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg; menu.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
		menu.Size = UDim2.new(0,90,0,0); menu.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
		menu.Visible = false; menu.ZIndex = 20; menu.Parent = screenGui
		addCorner(menu, T.Corner); addStroke(menu); addPadding(menu,3,3,3,3); addListLayout(menu, 2)

		local refs = {}
		local function makeMenuItem(name, text, lo)
			local btn = Instance.new("TextButton"); btn.Name = name
			btn.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; btn.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
			btn.Text = text; btn.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold; btn.Font = T.Font; btn.TextSize = 9
			btn.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,18); btn.BorderSizePixel = 0; btn.LayoutOrder = lo
			btn.AutoButtonColor = true; btn.Parent = menu; addCorner(btn, UDim.new(0,3)); table.insert(W.getThemed().blobs, btn)
			return btn
		end
		refs.CopyBtn = makeMenuItem("Copy", "Copy graph", 0)
		refs.PasteBtn = makeMenuItem("Paste", "Paste graph", 1)
		refs.ResetBtn = makeMenuItem("Reset", "Reset default", 2)
		refs.Menu = menu
		return refs
	end

	-- Per-user collapsed state of Properties sections, keyed "<Type>/<Section>" (plugin setting).
	local _sectionStore = {}
	local _sectionPlugin = nil
	function W.loadSectionState(pluginn)
		_sectionPlugin = pluginn
		local ok, saved = pcall(function() return pluginn:GetSetting("PropSectionCollapsed") end)
		_sectionStore = (ok and type(saved) == "table") and saved or {}
	end
	local function saveSectionState()
		if _sectionPlugin then pcall(function() _sectionPlugin:SetSetting("PropSectionCollapsed", _sectionStore) end) end
	end

	-- Line chevron for a collapse arrow. `arrow` keeps its "▼" / "▶" text as state (callers
	-- still write it) but hides it; the chevron turns to match.
	function W.attachChevron(arrow)
		arrow.TextTransparency = 1
		local chevron = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		chevron.Name = "Chevron"
		chevron.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		chevron.Text = "\u{203A}"
		chevron.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
		TypeScale.style(chevron, "Chevron")
		W.paint(chevron, "TextColor3", "TextSecondary")
		chevron.Parent = arrow

		local function turn()
			chevron.Rotation = arrow.Text == "▼" and 90 or 0
		end
		arrow:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(turn)
		turn()
		return chevron
	end

	-- Shows the rule above every visible section in `parent` except the first.
	local function refreshRules(parent)
		local sections = {}
		for _, child in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("Frame") and child.Visible and child:FindFirstChild("TopRule") then
				table.insert(sections, child)
			end
		end
		table.sort(sections, function(first, second)
			return first.LayoutOrder < second.LayoutOrder
		end)
		for index, section in ipairs(sections) do
			section.TopRule.Visible = index > 1
		end
	end

	-- Rule above a section: a line of `thickness` at the top of a spacer `height` tall.
	local function addTopRule(container, parent, thickness, height, role)
		local spacer = Instance.new("Frame")
		spacer.Name = "TopRule"
		spacer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		spacer.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height)
		spacer.LayoutOrder = -1
		spacer.Parent = container

		local line = Instance.new("Frame")
		line.Name = "Line"
		line.BorderSizePixel = 0
		line.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, thickness)
		W.paint(line, "BackgroundColor3", role)
		line.Parent = spacer

		container:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
			refreshRules(parent)
		end)
		container:GetPropertyChangedSignal("LayoutOrder"):Connect(function()
			refreshRules(parent)
		end)
		task.defer(refreshRules, parent)
	end

	-- The Classic section: a filled header box with a triangle arrow, for types and groups alike.
	local function makeClassicSection(parent, sectionName, order, startCollapsed, persistKey)
		local container = Instance.new("Frame")
		container.Name = sectionName:gsub("%s+", "") .. "Section"
		container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
		container.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
		container.LayoutOrder = order
		container.Parent = parent
		addListLayout(container, 0)

		local head = W.makeBlob("Header", container, UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, LAYOUT.GroupHead))
		head.LayoutOrder = 0

		local arrow = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		arrow.Name = "Arrow"
		arrow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		arrow.Text = startCollapsed and "▶" or "▼"
		arrow.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold
		arrow.Size = UDim2.new(0, 14, 1, 0)
		arrow.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 0)
		TypeScale.style(arrow, "Chevron")
		arrow.Parent = head

		local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		title.Name = "Title"
		title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		title.Text = sectionName
		title.TextColor3 = T.Gold
		title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, 0)
		title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 18, 0, 0)
		TypeScale.style(title, "Group")
		title.Parent = head

		local body = Instance.new("Frame")
		body.Name = "Body"
		body.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		body.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
		body.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
		body.LayoutOrder = 1
		body.Visible = not startCollapsed
		body.Parent = container
		addListLayout(body, LAYOUT.RowGap)
		addPadding(body, 4, 4, 4, 4)

		local toggle = Instance.new("TextButton")
		toggle.Name = "Toggle"
		toggle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		toggle.Text = ""
		toggle.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
		toggle.Parent = head
		toggle.Activated:Connect(function()
			body.Visible = not body.Visible
			arrow.Text = body.Visible and "▼" or "▶"
			if persistKey then
				_sectionStore[persistKey] = not body.Visible
				saveSectionState()
			end
		end)
		return container, body, head
	end

	-- Collapsible section. level 1 is a type section (Lightnings, Beams); any other value is a
	-- group inside one. persistKey (optional) makes the collapsed state survive sessions.
	-- Child names Header / Arrow / Title / Toggle / Body are looked up by PropertiesTabs/Pages.
	function W.makeSection(parent, sectionName, order, startCollapsed, persistKey, level)
		BuildPacer.step()
		local structure = C.MODE.Structure
		local isType = level == 1
		if persistKey and _sectionStore[persistKey] ~= nil then
			startCollapsed = _sectionStore[persistKey] == true
		end
		if structure.Classic then
			return makeClassicSection(parent, sectionName, order, startCollapsed, persistKey)
		end

		local container = Instance.new("Frame")
		container.Name = sectionName:gsub("%s+", "") .. "Section"
		container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
		container.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
		container.LayoutOrder = order
		container.Parent = parent
		addListLayout(container, 0)

		if isType and structure.TypeRule > 0 then
			addTopRule(container, parent, structure.TypeRule, LAYOUT.TypeGap / 2 + 4, "Rule")
		elseif not isType and structure.GroupDivider then
			addTopRule(container, parent, 1, 1, "Divider")
		end

		local head = Instance.new("Frame")
		head.Name = "Header"
		head.BorderSizePixel = 0
		head.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, isType and LAYOUT.TypeHead or LAYOUT.GroupHead)
		head.LayoutOrder = 0
		if isType and structure.TypeHeader == "Band" then
			W.paint(head, "BackgroundColor3", "Band")
			addCorner(head)
		else
			head.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		end
		head.Parent = container

		local chevronLeft = structure.ChevronSide == "Left"
		local arrow = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		arrow.Name = "Arrow"
		arrow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		arrow.Text = startCollapsed and "▶" or "▼"
		-- A left chevron fills the row indent, so titles and row labels share one left edge.
		local arrowSlot = chevronLeft and LAYOUT.RowIndent or LAYOUT.IconSlot
		arrow.Size = UDim2.new(0, arrowSlot, 1, 0)
		arrow.Position = chevronLeft and UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0) or UDim2.new(1, -arrowSlot, 0, 0)
		arrow.Parent = head
		W.attachChevron(arrow)

		local titleInset = chevronLeft and arrowSlot or 0
		local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		title.Name = "Title"
		title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		title.Text = sectionName
		title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		title.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
		title.Position = UDim2.new(0, titleInset, 0, 0)
		title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -LAYOUT.IconSlot, 1, 0)
		TypeScale.style(title, isType and "Type" or "Group")
		W.paint(title, "TextColor3", isType and "TextHeading" or "TextPrimary")
		title.Parent = head

		local body = Instance.new("Frame")
		body.Name = "Body"
		body.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		body.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
		body.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
		body.LayoutOrder = 1
		body.Visible = not startCollapsed
		body.Parent = container
		if isType then
			addListLayout(body, LAYOUT.GroupGap)
			addPadding(body, 0, 0, 4, 0)
		else
			addListLayout(body, LAYOUT.RowGap)
			addPadding(body, 0, 0, LAYOUT.GroupBodyTop, LAYOUT.OpenGroupGap)
		end

		local toggle = Instance.new("TextButton")
		toggle.Name = "Toggle"
		toggle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		toggle.Text = ""
		toggle.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
		toggle.Parent = head
		toggle.Activated:Connect(function()
			body.Visible = not body.Visible
			arrow.Text = body.Visible and "▼" or "▶"
			if persistKey then
				_sectionStore[persistKey] = not body.Visible
				saveSectionState()
			end
		end)
		return container, body, head
	end

	function W.makeExpandable(parent, labelText, children, order, hasBatchEdit)
		local outerBlob = W.makeBlob(labelText:gsub("%s+","").."Blob", parent, UDim2.new(1,0,0,0))
		outerBlob.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y; outerBlob.LayoutOrder = order or 0

		local wrapper = Instance.new("Frame"); wrapper.Name = labelText:gsub("%s+","").."Expandable"
		wrapper.BackgroundTransparency = 1; wrapper.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,0)
		wrapper.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y; wrapper.Parent = outerBlob
		addListLayout(wrapper, LAYOUT.RowGap); addPadding(wrapper, 4, 4, 4, 4)

		local headerRow = Instance.new("Frame"); headerRow.Name = "HeaderRow"; headerRow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		headerRow.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,LAYOUT.Row); headerRow.LayoutOrder = 0; headerRow.Parent = wrapper

		local arrow = Instance.new("TextLabel"); arrow.Name = "Arrow"; arrow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		arrow.Text = "▶"; arrow.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold; arrow.Font = T.Font; arrow.TextSize = 8
		arrow.Size = UDim2.new(0,12,1,0); arrow.Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0,0); arrow.Parent = headerRow

		local lbl = W.makeLabel("Label", headerRow, labelText, T.MutedGold, T.Font, 10)

		local batchBtn = nil
		if hasBatchEdit then
			lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1,-82,1,0); lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0,14,0,0)
			batchBtn = Instance.new("TextButton"); batchBtn.Name = "BatchEdit"
			batchBtn.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; batchBtn.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
			batchBtn.Text = "Edit Sel."; batchBtn.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold; batchBtn.Font = T.Font; batchBtn.TextSize = 8
			batchBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0,64,0,LAYOUT.Row-8); batchBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1,-66,0,4)
			batchBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0; batchBtn.ZIndex = 3; batchBtn.Parent = headerRow
			addCorner(batchBtn, UDim.new(0,4)); addStroke(batchBtn); table.insert(W.getThemed().blobs, batchBtn)
		else
			lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1,-14,1,0); lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0,14,0,0)
		end

		-- When hasBatchEdit, batchBtn occupies the right ~50px. clickBtn covers
		-- everything EXCEPT that area (1, -50, 1, 0) so the row header has no
		-- dead-zone where clicks go nowhere.
		local clickBtn = Instance.new("TextButton"); clickBtn.Name = "ClickExpand"; clickBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		clickBtn.Text = ""; clickBtn.Size = hasBatchEdit and UDim2.new(1,-70,1,0) or UDim2.new(1,0,1,0); clickBtn.Parent = headerRow

		local subBody = Instance.new("Frame"); subBody.Name = "SubBody"; subBody.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		subBody.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,0); subBody.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
		subBody.Visible = false; subBody.LayoutOrder = 1; subBody.Parent = wrapper; addListLayout(subBody, LAYOUT.RowGap)

		local elements = {}
		for i, child in ipairs(children) do elements[child.key or child.label] = child.builder(subBody, i) end
		clickBtn.Activated:Connect(function() subBody.Visible = not subBody.Visible; arrow.Text = subBody.Visible and "▼" or "▶" end)

		-- Helper to get checked axes (for batch editing)
		local getCheckedAxes = nil
		if hasBatchEdit then
			getCheckedAxes = function()
				local checked = {}
				for _, child in ipairs(children) do
					local key = child.key or child.label
					local elem = elements[key]
					if elem and elem.row and elem.row:GetAttribute("Checked") then
						table.insert(checked, key)
					end
				end
				return checked
			end
		end

		return outerBlob, elements, batchBtn, getCheckedAxes
	end

	-- =========================================================
	-- SLIDER
	-- =========================================================
	function W.makeSlider(parent, minVal, maxVal, defaultVal, onChanged, fmt, logScale)
		fmt = fmt or "%.2f"
		local c = Instance.new("Frame"); c.Name = "Slider"; c.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		c.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,28); c.Parent = parent
		local valLbl = Instance.new("TextBox"); valLbl.Name = "Val"; valLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		valLbl.Text = string.format(fmt, defaultVal); valLbl.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold
		valLbl.Font = T.Font; valLbl.TextSize = 16; valLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
		valLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,16); valLbl.ClearTextOnFocus = false; valLbl.BorderSizePixel = 0; valLbl.Parent = c
		local track = W.makeBlob("Track", c, UDim2.new(1,-4,0,6)); track.Position = UDim2.new(0,2,0,18)
		local fill = Instance.new("Frame"); fill.Name = "Fill"; fill.BackgroundColor3 = T.SliderFill or Color3.fromRGB(180,60,60)
		fill.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3; fill.BorderSizePixel = 0; fill.Size = UDim2.new(0.5,0,1,0); fill.Parent = track
		addCorner(fill, UDim.new(0,3)); table.insert(W.getThemed().fills, fill)
		local handle = Instance.new("TextButton"); handle.Name = "Handle"
		W.paint(handle, "BackgroundColor3", "BrightGold"); handle.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
		handle.Text = ""; handle.Size = UDim2.new(0,8,0,10); handle.Position = UDim2.new(0.5,-4,0,-2)
		handle.BorderSizePixel = 0; handle.Parent = track; addCorner(handle, UDim.new(0,4))
		-- Log-scale helpers (for multiplicative sliders like resize/retime: 0.5x–2x with 1x centered)
		local logRatio = logScale and math.log(maxVal / minVal) or 0
		local function valToAlpha(v)
			if logScale then return math.clamp(math.log(v / minVal) / logRatio, 0, 1) end
			return math.clamp((v - minVal) / (maxVal - minVal), 0, 1)
		end
		local function alphaToVal(a)
			if logScale then return minVal * math.exp(a * logRatio) end
			return minVal + (maxVal - minVal) * a
		end
		local cur = defaultVal
		local function setVal(v, silent)
			cur = v
			local a = valToAlpha(v); fill.Size = UDim2.new(a,0,1,0)
			handle.Position = UDim2.new(a,-4,0,-2); valLbl.Text = string.format(fmt, v)
			if not silent and onChanged then onChanged(v) end
		end
		local dragging = false
		local function upd(input) local ap = track.AbsolutePosition.X; local as = track.AbsoluteSize.X
			if as == 0 then return end; setVal(alphaToVal(math.clamp((input.Position.X-ap)/as,0,1)))
		end
		handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(i) if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dragging = true end end)
		handle.InputEnded:Connect(function(i) if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dragging = false end end)
		track.InputBegan:Connect(function(i) if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dragging = true; upd(i) end end)
		local c1 = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(i) if dragging and i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then upd(i) end end)
		local c2 = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(i) if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dragging = false end end)
		local uisC = W.getUISConnections(); table.insert(uisC, c1); table.insert(uisC, c2)
		-- Manual text input: allow values outside slider range (negatives + zero too); visual clamps to edges.
		valLbl.FocusLost:Connect(function() local raw = valLbl.Text:gsub("[^%d%.%-]",""); local n = tonumber(raw); if n then setVal(n) end end)
		setVal(defaultVal, true)
		return c, valLbl, setVal, function() return cur end
	end
	function W.addCollapseButton(header, bodyItems, opts)
		opts = opts or {}
		local arrow = Instance.new("TextButton"); arrow.Name = "CollapseArrow"
		arrow.BackgroundTransparency = 1; arrow.Text = "▼"; arrow.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold
		arrow.Font = T.Font; arrow.TextSize = 8; arrow.Size = UDim2.new(0,14,1,0)
		if not opts.anchorLeft then arrow.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1,0) end
		arrow.Position = opts.arrowPos or UDim2.new(1,-16,0,0)
		arrow.ZIndex = 3; arrow.Parent = header
		if not C.MODE.Structure.Classic then
			-- The same line chevron the section headers use; the text stays as the state.
			arrow.Size = UDim2.new(0, LAYOUT.IconSlot, 1, 0)
			W.attachChevron(arrow)
		end
		local expanded = true
		local lastExpandedSize = opts.expandedSize -- track actual size (updated on collapse)
		arrow.Activated:Connect(function()
			expanded = not expanded
			arrow.Text = expanded and "▼" or "▶"
			for _, item in ipairs(bodyItems) do item.Visible = expanded end
			if opts.panel and lastExpandedSize then
				local colW = opts.collapsedSize and opts.collapsedSize.X.Offset or lastExpandedSize.X.Offset
				local colH = opts.collapsedSize and opts.collapsedSize.Y.Offset or 38
				if expanded then
					opts.panel.Size = lastExpandedSize
				else
					-- The size to expand back to: the user's own, not one a push holds it at (PanelPush).
					lastExpandedSize = W.restingSize(opts.panel)
					opts.panel.Size = UDim2.new(0, colW, 0, colH)
				end
				local expH = lastExpandedSize.Y.Offset
				local delta = expH - colH
				-- Keep top edge stable for bottom-anchored panels (AnchorPoint.Y > 0)
				if opts.panel.AnchorPoint.Y > 0 then
					local p = opts.panel.Position
					local shift = expanded and delta or -delta
					opts.panel.Position = UDim2.new(p.X.Scale, p.X.Offset, p.Y.Scale, p.Y.Offset + shift)
				end
			end
		end)
		return arrow
	end
end

--[[
	WidgetSegments  -  the segmented strip: a row of text segments of which some are lit. Used for
	the Inventory's list tabs, group switch and filter tabs, and for the bottom bar's panel
	toggles, so they all look and behave alike.
	Loaded by Widgets.luau; receives the shared W table and adds:
	  W.makeSegmentStrip(parent, name) -> strip        field-coloured, outlined, laid out left to right
	  W.makeSegment(strip, name, text, order, options) -> button
	      options.fill   the segment shares the strip's spare width
	      options.soft   lit is a faint accent tint under bright text instead of a solid fill:
	                     for a strip where several segments are lit at once and only indicate a
	                     state (the bottom bar), where solid fills would outweigh everything else
	  W.paintSegment(button, active)                   lights or dims a segment
	A lit segment is a solid accent fill with on-accent text unless it is soft. An unlit one
	brightens under the cursor (not while something covers it, W.pointerBlocked).
	The lit state is kept here and repainted after a theme change.
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local TypeScale = require(script.Parent.TypeScale)
local T = C.T

-- How see-through a soft segment's accent tint is.
local SOFT_FILL_TRANSPARENCY = 0.78

return function(W)
	-- Segment -> lit / under the cursor / soft. Weak keys: segments are destroyed and rebuilt.
	local activeOf = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	local hoveredOf = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	local softOf = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	-- The themed table the repaint is registered in; a rebuild of the UI makes a new one.
	local registeredIn = nil

	local function paint(segment)
		if activeOf[segment] then
			if softOf[segment] then
				segment.BackgroundTransparency = SOFT_FILL_TRANSPARENCY
				segment.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold
			else
				segment.BackgroundTransparency = 0
				segment.TextColor3 = T.OnAccent
			end
			return
		end
		segment.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		segment.TextColor3 = hoveredOf[segment] and T.BrightGold or T.DarkGold
	end

	local function repaintAll()
		for segment in pairs(activeOf) do
			paint(segment)
		end
	end

	function W.makeSegmentStrip(parent, name)
		local strip = Instance.new("Frame")
		strip.Name = name
		strip.BorderSizePixel = 0
		W.paint(strip, "BackgroundColor3", "Field")
		strip.Parent = parent
		W.addCorner(strip)
		W.addStroke(strip)
		W.addPadding(strip, 2, 2, 2, 2)
		W.addListLayout(strip, 2, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal)
		return strip
	end

	function W.makeSegment(strip, name, text, order, options)
		local themed = W.getThemed()
		if registeredIn ~= themed then
			registeredIn = themed
			table.insert(themed.repaints, repaintAll)
		end

		local segment = Instance.new("TextButton")
		segment.Name = name
		segment.Text = text
		segment.AutoButtonColor = false
		segment.BorderSizePixel = 0
		segment.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
		segment.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
		segment.LayoutOrder = order
		TypeScale.style(segment, "Button")
		W.paint(segment, "BackgroundColor3", "Accent")
		segment.Parent = strip
		W.addCorner(segment, UDim.new(0, 4))
		W.addPadding(segment, 6, 6, 0, 0)
		if options and options.fill then
			local flex = Instance.new("UIFlexItem")
			flex.FlexMode = Enum.UIFlexMode.Fill
			flex.Parent = segment
		end

		activeOf[segment] = false
		softOf[segment] = (options and options.soft) or nil
		segment.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			if W.pointerBlocked(segment) then
				return
			end
			hoveredOf[segment] = true
			paint(segment)
		end)
		segment.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			hoveredOf[segment] = nil
			paint(segment)
		end)
		paint(segment)
		return segment
	end

	function W.paintSegment(segment, active)
		activeOf[segment] = active == true
		paint(segment)
	end
end

--[[
	WidgetToast  -  transient messages stacked at the bottom right of the plugin's ScreenGui.
	Loaded by Widgets.luau; receives the shared Widgets table and adds setToastParent and
	showToast to it.
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local Log = require(script.Parent.Parent.Part.Log)
local PanelSizes = require(script.Parent.PanelSizes)
local T = C.T

return function(Widgets)
	-- Toast notification system. Used for transient error / info messages that need to
	-- surface to the user without forcing a modal (e.g. "Model has no PrimaryPart").
	-- Stacks vertically in the bottom-right of the plugin's main ScreenGui. Auto-
	-- dismisses after `duration` seconds. Severity controls the accent stripe color:
	-- "info" (gold), "warn" (orange), "error" (red).
	local _toastStack = {} -- active toasts, top of stack = bottom of screen
	local _toastSG -- ScreenGui parent (lazy-initialized once we have ctx)

	-- Set the parent ScreenGui (called once from init.server.lua / UIBuilder).
	function Widgets.setToastParent(sg) _toastSG = sg end

	local TOAST_PAD = 8

	-- Classic's fixed size, or one that holds two lines of the mode's text.
	local function toastSize()
		if C.MODE.Structure.Classic then
			return 240, 48
		end
		local sizes = PanelSizes.get()
		return sizes.Toast, sizes.ToastHeight
	end

	local function _repositionToasts()
		local width, height = toastSize()
		for i, toast in ipairs(_toastStack) do
			toast.Position = UDim2.new(1, -width - 16, 1, -16 - i * (height + TOAST_PAD))
		end
	end

	function Widgets.showToast(message, severity, duration)
		if not _toastSG then Log.warn("[Part-Icles] showToast called before setToastParent: " .. tostring(message)); return end
		severity = severity or "info"
		duration = duration or 4
		local accentColor = severity == "error" and Color3.fromRGB(220, 80, 60)
			or severity == "warn" and Color3.fromRGB(220, 150, 60)
			or T.Gold

		local width, height = toastSize()
		local toast = Instance.new("Frame")
		toast.Name = "Toast"; toast.Size = UDim2.new(0, width, 0, height)
		toast.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
		toast.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg; toast.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
		toast.BorderSizePixel = 0; toast.ZIndex = 50; toast.Parent = _toastSG
		Widgets.addCorner(toast, T.Corner)
		Widgets.addStroke(toast)

		local stripe = Instance.new("Frame"); stripe.Name = "Accent"
		stripe.Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, 1, 0); stripe.BorderSizePixel = 0
		stripe.BackgroundColor3 = accentColor; stripe.ZIndex = 51; stripe.Parent = toast
		Widgets.addCorner(stripe, UDim.new(0, 2))

		local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel"); lbl.Name = "Msg"; lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0); lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, 0)
		lbl.Text = tostring(message); lbl.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold; lbl.Font = T.Font; lbl.TextSize = 11
		lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; lbl.TextWrapped = true; lbl.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
		lbl.ZIndex = 51; lbl.Parent = toast

		table.insert(_toastStack, toast)
		_repositionToasts()

		task.delay(duration, function()
			if toast and toast.Parent then
				for i, t in ipairs(_toastStack) do
					if t == toast then table.remove(_toastStack, i); break end
				end
				pcall(function() toast:Destroy() end)
				_repositionToasts()
			end
		end)
	end
end

--[[
	WidgetToggle  -  the on/off control: a switch or a checkbox, by theme mode.
	Loaded by Widgets.luau; receives the shared Widgets table and adds paintToggle, makeToggle
	and makeToggleInBlob to it.
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local TypeScale = require(script.Parent.TypeScale)
local T = C.T
local LAYOUT = C.LAYOUT

return function(Widgets)
	local addCorner, addStroke = Widgets.addCorner, Widgets.addStroke

	-- Distance between the knob and the track edge in a switch.
	local KNOB_INSET = 2

	-- Repaints a toggle from its IsOn and _toggleMixed attributes in the active mode's style.
	-- The mark keeps the name "Dot": a knob Frame in a switch, a tick TextLabel in a checkbox.
	function Widgets.paintToggle(toggle)
		local mark = toggle:FindFirstChild("Dot")
		if not mark then
			return
		end
		local isOn = toggle:GetAttribute("IsOn") == true
		local mixed = toggle:GetAttribute("_toggleMixed") == true
		local stroke = toggle:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")

		if mark:IsA("TextLabel") then
			toggle.BackgroundColor3 = isOn and T.ToggleOn or T.Field
			if stroke then
				stroke.Color = isOn and T.ToggleOn or T.ToggleOff
			end
			mark.TextColor3 = isOn and T.KnobOn or T.TextPrimary
			if mixed then
				mark.Text = "\u{2013}"
			elseif isOn then
				mark.Text = "\u{2713}"
			else
				mark.Text = ""
			end
			return
		end

		if stroke then
			stroke.Color = T.Border
		end
		-- The switch's own size: rows use the mode's switch, older panels a compact one.
		local width = toggle.Size.X.Offset
		local knob = mark.Size.X.Offset
		if mixed then
			toggle.BackgroundColor3 = T.ToggleOff
			mark.BackgroundColor3 = T.Warning
			mark.Position = UDim2.new(0, (width - knob) / 2, 0.5, 0)
		elseif isOn then
			toggle.BackgroundColor3 = T.ToggleOn
			mark.BackgroundColor3 = T.KnobOn
			mark.Position = UDim2.new(0, width - knob - KNOB_INSET, 0.5, 0)
		else
			toggle.BackgroundColor3 = T.ToggleOff
			mark.BackgroundColor3 = T.KnobOff
			mark.Position = UDim2.new(0, KNOB_INSET, 0.5, 0)
		end
	end

	-- The switch size panels laid out before the theme modes position their toggles for.
	local COMPACT = { Width = 28, Height = 16, Knob = 12 }

	-- On/off control: a switch or a checkbox, by mode. State lives in the IsOn attribute so an
	-- outside SetAttribute repaints it; `_toggleMixed` marks a multi-selection that disagrees.
	-- `roomy` uses the mode's full-size control; without it the toggle keeps the compact size.
	function Widgets.makeToggle(name, parent, roomy)
		local check = C.MODE.Structure.Toggle == "Check"
		local width = roomy and LAYOUT.ToggleWidth or (check and COMPACT.Height or COMPACT.Width)
		local height = roomy and LAYOUT.ToggleHeight or COMPACT.Height
		local knob = roomy and LAYOUT.Knob or COMPACT.Knob
		local toggle = Instance.new("TextButton")
		toggle.Name = name
		toggle.Text = ""
		toggle.Size = UDim2.new(0, width, 0, height)
		toggle.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
		toggle.BorderSizePixel = 0
		toggle.AutoButtonColor = false
		if parent then
			toggle.Parent = parent
		end
		addCorner(toggle, check and UDim.new(0, 4) or UDim.new(1, 0))
		addStroke(toggle)
		table.insert(Widgets.getThemed().toggles, toggle)

		local mark
		if check then
			mark = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			mark.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			mark.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
			TypeScale.style(mark, "Value")
		else
			mark = Instance.new("Frame")
			mark.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
			mark.Size = UDim2.new(0, knob, 0, knob)
			mark.BorderSizePixel = 0
			addCorner(mark, UDim.new(1, 0))
		end
		mark.Name = "Dot"
		mark.Parent = toggle

		toggle:SetAttribute("IsOn", false)
		toggle.Activated:Connect(function()
			toggle:SetAttribute("_toggleMixed", nil)
			toggle:SetAttribute("IsOn", not (toggle:GetAttribute("IsOn") == true))
		end)
		toggle:GetAttributeChangedSignal("IsOn"):Connect(function()
			Widgets.paintToggle(toggle)
		end)
		toggle:GetAttributeChangedSignal("_toggleMixed"):Connect(function()
			Widgets.paintToggle(toggle)
		end)
		Widgets.paintToggle(toggle)
		return toggle
	end

	-- A toggle in a row's value column. Classic boxes it like a field; the other modes use a plain
	-- frame, since a toggle needs no box.
	function Widgets.makeToggleInBlob(name, parent)
		if C.MODE.Structure.Classic then
			local blob = Widgets.makeBlob(name .. "Wrap", parent, UDim2.new(1, -LAYOUT.ContentOffset, 0, LAYOUT.Row))
			local boxed = Widgets.makeToggle(name, blob, true)
			boxed.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0.5, -LAYOUT.ToggleHeight / 2)
			return boxed, blob
		end
		local wrap = Instance.new("Frame")
		wrap.Name = name .. "Wrap"
		wrap.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		wrap.Size = UDim2.new(1, -LAYOUT.ContentOffset, 0, LAYOUT.Row)
		if parent then
			wrap.Parent = parent
		end
		local toggle = Widgets.makeToggle(name, wrap, true)
		toggle.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
		toggle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0)
		return toggle, wrap
	end
end
